steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Configure the event as a single-stage RFQ with whole-lot awarding.
Provide the required project title while keeping the participant omission as the only missing publish prerequisite.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified product and quantity without adding any participant.
Verify the product's mapped variant is filled automatically.
Set the required delivery location on the pricing sheet.
Verify the requested quantity was retained.
Commit the 30-minute schedule so the missing participant remains the relevant publish blocker.
Attempt publishing and assert that Procol refuses it with the required participant message.
